metadata.description: Free Crux skills for your own Claude.

plugins.name: crux-growth-skills
plugins.description: Growth skills for ecommerce brands by gocrux.io, written by operators who have scaled them. They work best with a Crux Growth Brain connected. The plugin carries two skills: a Black Friday plan (last year's Black Friday read on your own data, your November and December targets tested against it, and an agreed plan with day-by-day targets you can download) and a landing page audit (find your weakest pages, or audit any page from its URL, with prioritised fixes and a test backlog).
